g.text: Saved N / C_eff / G competition across higher-order formulas
ME01 · H4DF10 / H6DF19 (weighted completion), linear1 Å/STO-3G; T=.8/1.2/1.6/2; P=0; original saved higher-vs-S2 selections, full Hadamard RZ/opt1/seed17.
All 160 original ratio rows are shown in three separate dimensionless panels. Values are saved ratios, not newly divided fields. Text is rounded for display only; exact
C_eff is the original shot-weighted effective cost, not C_cos or C_sin. q/prefix may also change; these are finite-sample accounting comparisons, not causal factor
shares. Color range has extended ends.
